message.reasoning:
Let me evaluate.

C1: Mission concept and rationale. The student describes coral reef monitoring satellite for Great Barrier Reef, users (marine/conservation scientists), needs, references. Good but lacks specific mission goals/objectives/requirements (no explicit requirements, no orbit details correct). "geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km" — technical error (GEO is 35,786 km). That's a technical issue. C1: Accomplished or Adequate? Description is clear and relates function to users, references literature. But mission requirements not explicitly stated. I'd say Adequate-to-Accomplished. The rationale is well referenced and users identified. I'd give 8/10 Accomplished, or 6 Adequate. The mission goals are described (monitoring bleaching, SST, bathymetry) with users. I'll give 8.

C2: Project plan with Gantt chart, information sources. Gantt chart present, detailed task descriptions, references listed (URLs). Plan fits mission narrative. Contingencies? Not much provision for variations. Adequate-Accomplished. Plan is robust with weekly breakdown; references included. I'd give 7-8. Lack of contingency provision — give 7.

C3: Preliminary progress: completed STK tutorials 1-4, background research, mission concept. Some work done but no technical results (no calculations, no orbit analysis — and the orbit statement is wrong). Minor work completed; interpretation insufficient. Adequate: 5. Actually "completed STK tutorials" and research is some work; no preliminary results. Give 4-5. I'll say 5.

C4: Presentation: clear structure, headings, well-written, references cited with footnotes matching list. Figures labelled (Image 1 Gantt chart, described). Good. Minor: footnote-style URLs rather than formal reference list; but text citations match. Accomplished: 8.

Requirements:
R1: yes — mission concept benefits Australia, users, rationale.
R2: partial — plan mentions launch/orbit but "geostationary at 600 km" error; relates to space segment partially.
R3: yes — STK selected ("STK Design", "STK Simulations").
R4: yes — Gantt chart.
R5: yes — four URLs listed as sources; though these are used sources rather than "plan to use" — still listed. Met.
R6: partial — only tutorials and research, no technical results.

Technical issues: GEO altitude error (600 km is LEO, not geostationary; a 600 km orbit can't be geostationary and wouldn't keep satellite fixed above reef). Also "Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic" — actually surface ocean acidity increased ~30% since industrial revolution, that's fine. "bleaching killed 60 percent... 2017 another 50 percent" — roughly matches reports. Also near-real-time relay from GEO for imaging — resolution issues, but main error is orbit.

Overall: solid report with one notable technical error.
